reelObservations: The footage follows an encounter that began when a driver refused to speak to a female deputy while her disabled car sat stranded in traffic lanes. Bodycam and dispatch records reveal she repeatedly called 911 demanding towing info and insulting call takers, leading deputies to track her down and arrest her on foot for misuse of 911.

spine.reason: Tracking from teaser confrontation to inciting roadside incident, followed by the abusive 911 call and final custodial arrest, delivers an airtight, fast-paced escalation arc.
